agent_explanation: Single elastic ball bouncing on arena floor with large dt (~0.021) gains energy at the contact: incoming speed ~8.21 at step 76 becomes outgoing ~9.39 at step 77, raising total energy from ~41.9J to ~53.26J with zero controller work. Likely positional correction and/or impulse-plus-gravity ordering during multi-substep floor contact injects energy when e=1 preserves it; lowering e to 0.9 dissipates it and removes the violation.
